title: Schroders launches tokenized emerging markets debt fund on Solana with Centrifuge
message_html: Schroders launches tokenized emerging markets debt fund on Solana with Centrifuge ...
snippet: The $1 trillion-plus asset manager brings its emerging markets bond strategy to Solana, expanding the range of onchain actively managed funds.

title: Wall Street’s Plumbing Goes Onchain as Morgan Stanley Tokenizes Securities
message_html: Wall Street’s Plumbing Goes Onchain as Morgan Stanley Tokenizes Securities ...
snippet: Morgan Stanley says it has converted U.S. equities and Treasuries into tokenized form through the newly launched DTCC Tokenization Service, which 20 Wall Street firms have signed up to use.
